metadata.name: Task Breakdown Flow
metadata.description: Turns one already authorized bounded multi-step task into a strict ordered plan and carries it to a verified result without imposing a software-development lifecycle. It reuses the supplied task, resolves autonomous or interactive operation once, and works either in an execution-bound filesystem workspace or with a bounded in-memory fallback that makes no durable-recovery claim. Plan items have stable unique IDs, valid dependencies, actions, and observable expected results. An independent reviewer must clear the complete plan before sequential execution. Each item records concrete evidence and passes an independent primary-source review before the engine advances its cursor. A failed item receives at most two materially changed attempts; exhaustion enters an explicit interactive recovery decision or a truthful autonomous recovery outcome. Guarded process revision replaces only the remaining suffix while preserving the independently verified prefix and its evidence. After all items, an independent final review checks every success criterion, actual result, projections, evidence, and authority; findings return to the earliest stale owner and clean completion requires exactly zero blockers. Interactive mode supports explicit plan approval and result rework, while autonomous mode skips only those human waits. Outcomes distinguish clean, limited, aborted, and recovery states and expose only bounded summaries and safe artifact locations. The originating request is the authority ceiling; approval, retries, recovery, or available tools do not authorize destructive, external, production, publication, financial, administrative, privacy-sensitive, commit, push, deployment, or notification actions. Choose this flow when a task needs decomposition plus per-item retry/recovery and must also work without filesystem access. Choose Simple Plan Execution for the minimal filesystem-backed current-plan executor, Quick Task for immutable decision history, Robust Task for stronger durable checkpoints and recovery, Todo List for an already supplied checklist, or Software Development Flow for one complete implementation lifecycle including tests, documentation, review, release, and deployment. Do not split one development lifecycle across several general task runs.

nodes.directive: Establish the complete bounded task contract from the triggering conversation. Reuse every explicit fact and inspect non-mutating context when useful; ask only for a material unknown that cannot be discovered. Resolve `operating_mode` once (`autonomous` skips only human plan/result waits; `interactive` keeps them). Resolve `storage_mode=filesystem` only when this host can safely create local files, otherwise `memory`; do not run a separate capability-onboarding conversation. Return the canonical task description, observable whole-task expected result, 1..20 measurable success criteria, applicable constraints, and an explicit authority boundary inherited from the originating request and host policy. Do not plan or execute. Approval, mode, retry, recovery, and tool availability never authorize destructive, external, production, publication, financial, administrative, privacy-sensitive, commit, push, deployment, or communication actions absent from the original authority.
nodes.completionCondition: A bounded canonical task, one operating mode, one storage mode, and the originating authority ceiling are established without re-asking known facts

nodes.directive: Write `./moira-ws/task-breakdown-{{executionId}}/task.md` as the exact durable projection of the canonical task_description, expected_result, success_criteria, constraints, and authority_boundary supplied by workflow state. Use labeled sections and preserve every string exactly; no second task authority. Read it back and verify equality. Return {} only.
nodes.completionCondition: task.md exactly projects the complete canonical task contract in the current execution workspace

nodes.directive: Create one proportionate ordered plan for the canonical task. Return 1..32 items with pairwise-unique stable IDs, nonblank actions, observable expected results, and dependencies containing only earlier item IDs. Cover every success criterion without fixed counts, estimates, absolute paths, named tools, commits, tests, or duplicated cross-cutting work unless this task requires them. Do not execute. In filesystem mode, write `./moira-ws/task-breakdown-{{executionId}}/plan.json` as exactly the returned JSON array and verify deep equality; in memory mode, the bounded returned array is canonical. Return only steps.
nodes.completionCondition: A complete strict plan with unique identities and valid dependencies exists as the single canonical plan and exact file projection when applicable

nodes.directive: Delegate a complete plan review to an independent host-supported context; do not self-review or require a named client tool. The reviewer must inspect the current execution's canonical task and steps directly. In filesystem mode also read task.md and plan.json and block on any projection mismatch. Verify full task/criteria coverage, pairwise-unique IDs, dependency existence/order, observable results, proportionality, authority, and absence of unjustified universal process rules. In filesystem mode overwrite `./moira-ws/task-breakdown-{{executionId}}/plan-review.md` with detailed findings; in memory mode return bounded findings_summary. Diagnose only. Return exact plan_issues_count and findings_summary, which must be empty exactly at zero and nonempty at nonzero.
nodes.completionCondition: An independent current plan review reports every reproducible blocker and exact count without repairing

nodes.directive: Read and reproduce every current plan finding from workflow state and, in filesystem mode, plan-review.md. If a meaningful authorized repair exists, materially repair the canonical plan at its earliest source; preserve the exact evidenced prefix before current_step, change only the remaining suffix, keep pairwise-unique IDs and valid earlier-only dependencies, and in filesystem mode atomically project the exact returned array to plan.json. Return repair_status=`changed` with steps. If no authorized meaningful change exists, return repair_status=`blocked` with a bounded nonblank blocked_reason and do not mutate the plan.
nodes.completionCondition: The plan is materially repaired or the inability to repair is represented explicitly without an unchanged loop

nodes.directive: Present the complete current plan and explain that items before zero-based current_step are already independently verified. Ask for an explicit decision. Return `accept` only for acceptance; return `revise` with complete nonblank feedback otherwise. Do not revise or execute.
nodes.completionCondition: The interactive user accepted the current zero-reviewed plan or supplied bounded revision feedback

nodes.directive: Materially revise the current plan from `{{present_plan.feedback}}`. Preserve exact IDs, content, order, and evidence for every item before current_step; replace only the remaining suffix, retain unique IDs and valid dependencies, and do not broaden authority. In filesystem mode atomically project the returned steps to plan.json. Return changed steps only.
nodes.completionCondition: The plan materially addresses user feedback and preserves the verified prefix

nodes.directive: Execute only current item `{{steps[current_step].id}}`: {{steps[current_step].action}}. Expected result: {{steps[current_step].expected_result}}. Honor its earlier dependencies, canonical task, constraints, and authority_boundary. {{#if retry_count}}Use the materially changed retry approach: {{prepare_retry.retry_approach}}. Do not repeat unchanged work.{{/if}} Perform discriminating verification. Update evidence_ledger without altering or dropping earlier entries: append or replace only the current item record with its stable ID, status (`verified` only when proved, otherwise `failed`), bounded actual result, and concrete verification. In filesystem mode append the detailed attempt and primary evidence to execution-evidence.md. Return execution_status and the complete bounded ledger; never claim success when blocked, failed, or unevidenced.
nodes.completionCondition: One authorized current-item attempt has an observed status and bounded evidence without corrupting the verified prefix

nodes.directive: In an independent host-supported context, review only current item `{{steps[current_step].id}}` against its action, expected result, dependencies, actual state, and primary evidence. Verify that evidence_ledger preserves the exact verified prefix with one unambiguous record per stable ID and that the current verified claim is real and authorized. In filesystem mode directly read execution-evidence.md and overwrite item-review.md with details. Diagnose only. Return exact item_issues_count and findings_summary, empty exactly at zero and nonempty at nonzero; only when nonzero also return item_repair_reach=`work` for execution/evidence defects or `plan` when the remaining plan itself is wrong.
nodes.completionCondition: An independent primary-source item review returns the exact current blockers and earliest repair owner

nodes.directive: Reproduce the current failure and review findings from primary evidence. If one authorized materially different attempt exists, return retry_status=`changed` and a bounded nonblank retry_approach that addresses the confirmed cause; do not perform work here. If no meaningful changed attempt exists within authority, return retry_status=`blocked` and a bounded nonblank blocked_reason. Never invent an approach to keep the loop alive.
nodes.completionCondition: A changed retry approach or explicit blocker is represented in a closed schema

nodes.directive: Bounded changed retries are exhausted. Do not guess a skip or expand authority. Return a concise factual result_summary and a nonblank limitation_reason naming the stopped stable item, verified attempts, blocker, and safe next decision. Do not claim completion.
nodes.completionCondition: The autonomous run has a bounded truthful recovery summary and reason

nodes.directive: Explain the current item, attempts, and blocker. Ask the interactive user to choose: `assist` with nonblank guidance, `skip` with nonblank accepted limitation, `revise` with nonblank plan feedback, `stop` with nonblank recovery reason, or `abort` with nonblank reason. The decision cannot expand originating authority. Return only the closed decision shape; do not perform work.
nodes.completionCondition: The user made one explicit bounded recovery decision with route-required data

nodes.directive: Use the user's bounded guidance at `{{ask_recovery.reason}}` to materially change only the current authorized work. Perform discriminating verification; update only the current item record in evidence_ledger while preserving the verified prefix, and append detailed evidence in filesystem mode. Return the complete ledger only after the expected result is actually proved. User guidance never bypasses independent review.
nodes.completionCondition: User-assisted changed work has current evidence and is ready for independent item review

nodes.directive: Record the explicit skipped current stable item and exact accepted limitation `{{ask_recovery.reason}}` in evidence_ledger, preserving the verified prefix. In filesystem mode append the decision to execution-evidence.md. Return the cumulative nonblank limitation_reason and the complete ledger. Do not claim the item verified.
nodes.completionCondition: The skip and its limitation are durably and truthfully preserved

nodes.directive: Return a concise factual result_summary and the exact nonblank limitation_reason from `{{ask_recovery.reason}}`. Include completed versus total count; do not claim completion.
nodes.completionCondition: The explicit abort reason and partial result are represented truthfully

nodes.directive: Return a concise factual result_summary and the exact nonblank limitation_reason from `{{ask_recovery.reason}}`, naming the current stable item and safe next decision. Do not claim completion.
nodes.completionCondition: The explicit stop reason and partial result are represented truthfully

nodes.directive: Revise the process because the current remaining plan is demonstrably wrong or because the interactive recovery decision requested revision. Return one complete strict replacement steps array. Preserve exact IDs, content, order, and evidence correspondence before the engine-owned current_step; replace only the remaining suffix, retain unique IDs and valid earlier-only dependencies, and stay within authority. In filesystem mode atomically project steps to plan.json. Do not return or choose a cursor, and do not use revision to bypass ordinary failed work or review findings owned by work repair.
nodes.completionCondition: A strict replacement plan preserves the verified prefix while the engine retains its cursor

nodes.directive: Assemble a bounded current result from the canonical task, plan, evidence_ledger, actual state, and declared limitations. In filesystem mode write a current draft into final-report.md for review; in memory mode retain the bounded result_summary. Return result_summary only. Do not claim clean completion or ask for acceptance before independent final review.
nodes.completionCondition: A bounded truthful current result is available for independent final review

nodes.directive: In an independent host-supported context, inspect the complete canonical task, plan, evidence_ledger, actual result, primary evidence, authority, and current report. In filesystem mode directly read task.md, plan.json, execution-evidence.md, and final-report.md, verify all projections belong to execution `{{executionId}}`, and overwrite final-review.md. Check every success criterion, stable-ID correspondence, sequential completeness, current skip/limitation state, actual outcome truth, and authority. Diagnose only. Return exact final_issues_count and findings_summary, empty exactly at zero and nonempty at nonzero. At zero also return reviewed_outcome=`clean` only when the current ledger contains no unresolved skipped item, otherwise `limited` with a current nonblank limitation_reason. Only when nonzero return final_repair_reach plus repair_from for task/plan/work.
nodes.completionCondition: An independent primary-source final review records every blocker and derives the current truthful outcome

nodes.directive: Read and reproduce every independent final finding. If no meaningful authorized repair exists, return repair_status=`blocked` with bounded nonblank blocked_reason and mutate nothing. Otherwise materially repair the complete current set at its earliest source and return repair_status=`changed` plus final_repair_reach. For projection, change the bounded result_summary and, in filesystem mode, synchronize final-report.md, then return the changed summary. For task/plan return repair_from and exactly the ordered proven evidence before that index; for work return the prior prefix plus the corrected verified record at that index. Return the required canonical fields only for their declared reach. In filesystem mode synchronize projections and remove stale detailed evidence from repair_from onward. Do not edit the review or loop unchanged.
nodes.completionCondition: Every finding is materially repaired with exclusive outputs and deterministic evidence invalidation, or a blocked repair is explicit

nodes.directive: Do not modify the zero-reviewed final-report.md, result_summary, evidence, plan, task, or actual work. Verify that the exact reviewed artifact remains current. In filesystem mode return artifact_location exactly `./moira-ws/task-breakdown-{{executionId}}/final-report.md`; in memory mode return exactly `in-memory execution context`. Return only that non-substantive discovery location.
nodes.completionCondition: The exact independently reviewed result remains unchanged and has a safe caller-facing location

nodes.directive: Present the complete current zero-reviewed result and ask for explicit acceptance. Return `accept` only for acceptance; return `rework` with complete bounded nonblank feedback otherwise. Do not change work here.
nodes.completionCondition: The interactive user accepted the current result or supplied rework feedback

nodes.directive: Reproduce feedback `{{present_result.feedback}}` and apply it at the earliest authorized source. Return final_repair_reach matching the actual mutation. For projection, change and return bounded result_summary and, in filesystem mode, synchronize final-report.md. For task/plan return repair_from and exactly the ordered evidence before that index; for work return the prior prefix plus the corrected verified record at that index. Return task/plan fields only for their declared reach. In filesystem mode remove stale detailed evidence from repair_from onward. Do not claim acceptance; every affected independent gate is stale.
nodes.completionCondition: Result feedback is materially applied with an exclusive changed projection or canonical/work reach

nodes.hint: Use only when the remaining process is demonstrably wrong, incomplete, or obsolete; never to bypass a failed item, independent finding, authority, or evidence gate.
nodes.directive: Return a complete strict replacement steps array. Preserve exact IDs, content, order, and evidence for every verified item before the engine-owned current_step; replace only the remaining suffix with unique IDs and valid earlier-only dependencies. Stay within original authority. In filesystem mode atomically project the returned array to plan.json. Do not return or choose a cursor, execute work, or edit completed evidence.
nodes.completionCondition: The revised process preserves the verified prefix while the engine retains the explicit current cursor

nodes.directive: Return a bounded factual result_summary and limitation_reason copied from the blocked plan repair at `{{repair_plan.blocked_reason}}`. Do not claim execution or completion.
nodes.completionCondition: The blocked plan repair becomes a truthful recovery result

nodes.directive: The changed plan is shorter than the engine-owned verified prefix. Return a factual bounded result_summary and nonblank limitation_reason; do not execute, rewind, skip, or claim completion.
nodes.completionCondition: An invalid revision stops as a truthful recovery outcome

nodes.directive: Return a bounded factual result_summary and limitation_reason copied from the blocked final repair at `{{repair_final.blocked_reason}}`. Preserve the last verified partial result and do not claim clean completion.
nodes.completionCondition: A blocked final repair becomes a truthful recovery outcome

completed_items.description: Engine-owned verified or explicitly limited prefix count

retry_count.description: Engine-owned changed-attempt count for current item

evidence_ledger.description: Bounded stable-ID evidence acknowledgements for the completed/current prefix

plan_issues_count.description: Exact current independent plan blocker count

item_issues_count.description: Exact current independent item blocker count

final_issues_count.description: Exact current independent final blocker count

findings_summary.description: Bounded routing summary of current independent findings

item_repair_reach.description: Earliest owner for a failed item review

limitation_reason.description: Required factual reason for non-clean outcome

artifact_location.description: Safe current result location or explicit in-memory location
